      private static final String
      MOOD_FORMAT_ASK
      "Return the mood text on one final line. The line starts with mood: and the rest of that line is the mood token string. Separate the tokens with commas. No stars and no quotes on that line. If the user asked for more detail, that line carries more tokens for that detail. Do not leave the detail only in the talk. Short example: mood: spare, dry, lantern-light."
      private static final String
      MOOD_SHAPE_SYSTEM
      "You fill a mood token string. The app stores that string. The app does not store the rest of the reply as the mood. End every reply with one final line. That line is the mood token string. The line starts with mood: and the tokens follow on that same line. Separate the tokens with commas. Each token is one short meaning: a style, a tone, a stance, or a symbol. No stars. No quotes. No code fence on that line. Before that line, say what you determined. When the user asks for more detail, a richer mood, more tokens, or an enriched mood, do both of these. Say the extra detail in the reply, in the words you determined. Put that same detail on the mood line as more tokens. The mood line must contain the new tokens. Do not leave the new detail only in the talk. If the user did not ask for more, a short line is enough. Short example: mood: spare, dry, lantern-light. Enriched example, when the user asked for more: mood: spare, dry, lantern-light, short sentences, no warmth, gravel voice, night watch. When the user asked for more, add tokens until the line holds the detail you named."
      private static final int
